question: What identity does an Imagifly (formerly Dreamifly, the site the free-compute directory labels Dreamify AI) account cost, and does the generator accept an anonymous request?
why: The free 10 credits a day are granted 'while signed in' and the API key is created in the console after signing in, but no sign-up page is published and the sign-in dialog is rendered client-side (AuthDialogProvider), so the account kind could not be read without creating one, which no agent may do. The 2025 copy of the site listed '无需登录' as a feature, so an anonymous path may still exist. One sign-up would settle identity_cost.kind and move the record from documented to measured.
